mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE raw_disease AS ( SELECT patient_id, TRIM(REPLACE(disease, ';', ',')) AS remaining FROM patients WHERE disease IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(disease) <> '' ), split_disease AS ( SELECT patient_id, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(remaining, ',', 1)) AS token, CASE WHEN INSTR(remaining, ',') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTRING(remaining, INSTR(remaining, ',') + 1) END AS remaining FROM raw_disease UNION ALL SELECT patient_id, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(remaining, ',', 1)) AS token, CASE WHEN INSTR(remaining, ',') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTRING(remaining, INSTR(remaining, ',') + 1) END AS remaining FROM split_disease WHERE remaining <> '' ), canonical_disease AS ( SELECT patient_id, CASE LOWER(token) WHEN 'healthy' THEN NULL WHEN 'health' THEN NULL WHEN 'healthy subject study' THEN NULL WHEN 'control' THEN NULL WHEN 'nc' THEN NULL WHEN 'normal control' THEN NULL WHEN 'ibd' THEN 'inflammatory bowel disease' WHEN 't2d' THEN 'type 2 diabetes' WHEN 'type 2 diabetes' THEN 'type 2 diabetes' WHEN 'crc' THEN 'colorectal cancer' WHEN 'pd' THEN 'parkinson disease' WHEN 'parkinsons disease' THEN 'parkinson disease' WHEN 'ms' THEN 'multiple sclerosis' WHEN 'ad' THEN 'alzheimer disease' WHEN 'alzheimers' THEN 'alzheimer disease' WHEN 'mci' THEN 'mild cognitive impairment' WHEN 'cad' THEN 'coronary artery disease' WHEN 'hf' THEN 'heart failure' WHEN 'fatty_liver' THEN 'fatty liver' WHEN 'perianal_fistula' THEN 'perianal fistula' WHEN 'cholesterolemia' THEN 'hypercholesterolemia' WHEN 'premature born' THEN 'prematurity' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(token, '_', ' '))) END AS disease FROM split_disease WHERE token <> '' ), normalized_diseases AS ( SELECT DISTINCT patient_id, disease FROM canonical_disease WHERE disease IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(disease) <> '' )
mapper.select: SELECT disease AS disease, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM normalized_diseases GROUP BY disease ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT disease AS disease_name, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM normalized_diseases GROUP BY disease ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disease) FROM normalized_diseases ) AS disease_category_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) FROM patients WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(country) != '' ) AS region_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE LOWER(TRIM(disease)) IN ('healthy', 'health', 'healthy subject study') ) AS healthy_patient_count, ( SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(LOWER(TRIM(disease)) IN ('healthy', 'health', 'healthy subject study')) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM patients ) AS healthy_ratio, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT microbe_name_hash) FROM microbe_abundance_standard ) AS species_feature_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM microbe_abundance_standard ) AS standard_abundance_record_count

SELECT CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10' WHEN age BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20' WHEN age BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21-30' WHEN age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31-40' WHEN age BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '41-50' WHEN age BETWEEN 51 AND 60 THEN '51-60' ELSE '60+' END AS age_group, gender, COUNT(*) as count FROM patients WHERE gender IS NOT NULL AND age BETWEEN 1 AND 120 GROUP BY age_group, gender;
SELECT country as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM patients WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND country != '' GROUP BY country ORDER BY value DESC;
